Five camps

Lost Dungeons

Five camps, each with its own purse and its own shelf. Nothing here yet. The Wayfarers take anyone from level 15, and wins are counted for this character alone rather than for the account.

No Adventurer’s Stone yet. Speak to a Wayfarer recruiter in your home city, then to the camp itself. It answers four questions and hands one over, and the camp portals will not carry you without it. How to start.

These are this character’s alone. Adventure wins and points are kept against the character, not the account, so an alt starts at nothing however far this one has come, the opposite of the gates and flags above. The dungeons, the runs and the shelves.
